comments.content: [medium] Using `\n` instead of `std::endl` in these error messages drops the implicit flush, which can postpone when the error actually shows up in the terminal. For error reporting, output needs to reach the terminal right away — please revert to `std::endl`.
[low] Consider enriching this error message with the offending file or parameter path, so users can locate the source of the parse failure without extra debugging.
[low] It might be useful to add a small regression test that feeds a malformed configuration file through the parser and asserts the expected error text is produced, locking in this path's behavior.
